verdict.rationale: Asana's docs describe rules as a platform feature: "rule actions" for automating work, app components that build on the surface of rules, and AI Studio marketed as no-code automations. A third-party integration (PagerDuty) explicitly uses Rules to fire actions from task context, and webhooks provide event notifications for code-driven triggers. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the rule builder itself (available triggers, conditions, action types, limits), detail on how AI Studio automations are defined and triggered, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that rules work as described.
